description: The app's own page may call two commands of the app's own, api_token and pick_folder (the system's folder panel for the Code lane's Workspace, 6b628); each checks the page's origin against the sidecar's port before answering (6b532). The header drags the window and a double-click on it zooms, as a title bar's would (the Mac shell's corner: the page runs under the title bar).
